description: DOCK11 median expression across GTEx v8 tissues
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

g=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
               params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000147251.15","datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100},timeout=120).json()
df=pd.DataFrame(g.get("data",[]))
print(df.shape, df.columns.tolist()[:10])
if len(df):
    df=df.rename(columns={"tissueSiteDetailId":"tissue"}).sort_values("median",ascending=False)
    print(df[["tissue","median"]].head(12).to_string(index=False))
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,11))
    d=df.sort_values("median")
    ax.barh(d.tissue,d["median"],color="#1e8449")
    ax.set_xlabel("Median TPM (GTEx v8)"); ax.tick_params(labelsize=6.5)
    ax.set_title("DOCK11 expression across human tissues (GTEx v8)\nhighest in spleen, whole blood and EBV-transformed lymphocytes",fontsize=11)
    ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
